reconfigure.title: Connect a PixLite Mk3
reconfigure.description: Enter the controller address. Set port to 0 to use HTTP 80 or HTTPS 4443. For Advatek HTTPS, enter its IPv4 address and the MAC from its label. Leave MAC blank only for conventional hostname and CA validation. The controller must be on a reachable subnet.

reauth_confirm.title: Connect a PixLite Mk3
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the controller address. Set port to 0 to use HTTP 80 or HTTPS 4443. For Advatek HTTPS, enter its IPv4 address and the MAC from its label. Leave MAC blank only for conventional hostname and CA validation. The controller must be on a reachable subnet.

user.title: Connect a PixLite Mk3
user.description: Discover controllers on the enabled Home Assistant network interfaces, or enter an address manually. Use addresses in the same subnet for a direct connection.

manual.title: Connect a PixLite Mk3
manual.description: Enter the controller address. Set port to 0 to use HTTP 80 or HTTPS 4443. For Advatek HTTPS, enter its IPv4 address and the MAC from its label. Leave MAC blank only for conventional hostname and CA validation. The controller must be on a reachable subnet.

discovery_confirm.title: Connect a PixLite Mk3
discovery_confirm.description: Connect to the controller at {host}. Its MAC address will be checked through the authenticated API before it is added. Set port to 0 to use HTTP 80 or HTTPS 4443. For Advatek HTTPS, enter the controller MAC from its label. Leave MAC blank only for conventional hostname and CA validation. Use a reachable controller address.

select_device.title: Discovered PixLite controllers
select_device.description: Choose the controller to connect. Discovery does not change controller configuration or output.

no_devices.title: PixLite discovery
no_devices.description: No compatible controllers were found. Check enabled network interfaces, firewall and multicast access, or enter the address manually. Use addresses in the same subnet for a direct connection.

scan_failed.title: PixLite discovery
scan_failed.description: Discovery was incomplete or no enabled IPv4 interfaces were available. Try again or enter the controller address manually.

error.invalid_host: Enter an IPv4 address or hostname without a scheme, path or port.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Check the user and password.
error.unsupported_device: A PixLite Mk3 supporting API v1.9 is required.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot communicate with the controller. Check address, credentials, network and TLS certificate.
error.certificate_untrusted: HTTPS certificate chain is not trusted. Obtain the Advatek root CA and configure trust in the Home Assistant runtime.
error.certificate_identity: HTTPS certificate identity does not match the configured controller. Check the MAC address against its label.
error.certificate_purpose: HTTPS certificate is not valid for TLS server authentication. Contact Advatek.
error.certificate_validity: HTTPS certificate is expired or not yet valid. Check the Home Assistant clock and contact Advatek.
error.certificate_invalid: HTTPS certificate validation failed. Contact Advatek for the correct certificate setup.
error.invalid_mac: Enter the controller MAC from its label, for example AC:DE:48:00:00:80.
error.identity_mismatch: The API reports a different controller MAC address. Rescan and select the intended controller.
error.scan_incomplete: The scan was incomplete. These are partial results; additional controllers may be missing.

abort.wrong_device: This is a different controller. Add it as another integration entry.
abort.invalid_discovery: The discovery information is invalid. Rescan or enter the address manually.
abort.device_not_found: The selected controller is no longer in this scan. Scan again.
abort.cannot_connect: The discovered address could not be verified with the saved credentials. The saved address was not changed.
